git.note: The worktree was created from the RFC003 evidence commit and was clean before the first edit; no git clean, reset or stash was run at any point.

tests_before_edits.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/unit/vision tests/unit/paper tests/unit/risk tests/unit/market_data -q -p no:warnings
tests_before_edits.note: Started on the untouched worktree; pytest resolved the modules at collection, before the first edit. The log is preserved outside the evidence commit because it is 224 bytes of progress dots and a summary line.

src/trading_bot/vision/ledger.py.append: lines 150-160 (open append, write one chained line, flush, fsync)

src/trading_bot/vision/lane.py.commit_call: line 1453 _commit(barrier_ms=ts) at the end of every bar; 1819 _commit definition

authority_finding.reason: durable.py states it and the runtime enforces it: reconcile_book() judges BOOK.json, never the ledger; the lane restores the broker and the risk engine from the book only.
authority_finding.rfc_assumption_contradicted: RFC004 section 5.1 proposes canonical_book_state = deterministic_replay(committed_ledger_prefix). The runtime cannot honour that without inverting its authority, so the design preserves the existing contract and documents the deviation in EVIDENCE_DECISION below.

network.vision_lane_import_graph: no ccxt; the only network-capable import reachable from the lane is vision/provider.py (httpx), and the lane is given a provider object
network.isolation_before_edits: none at process level: the RFC003 incident (ccxt.binance() opening HTTP in its constructor) is the evidence

known_defects_at_baseline: The commit that books a gap reconstruction published risk_equity != marked_equity (9997.26097534 vs 9996.3809662 on the RFC004 seed), so a crash after it left a book no resume could accept (RISK_MISMATCH).
No failpoint existed on any persistence call, so the ledger-fsync -> book-replace window had never been interrupted in the real runtime.
A torn tail in BOOK_EVENTS.jsonl or in a session ledger raised on the next open instead of being classified.
A CLOSE row had no economic identity, so a re-executed bar appended a second row for one effect.
runtime_hash_policy: sha256 of the LF text (the blob at 0c074fb); autocrlf=true would make raw bytes machine-dependent
